_note: Items (bible §7). Seal scrolls are the sealing item: you need one to try a seal. Effects: window (timing windows x), typeWindow + types (extra x when the foe is one of those types), bond (added to the score for the bond only, not for whether it seals), glass (any miss breaks it; all perfect is a guaranteed strong bond), echo (the beat plays once before you tap), tries (attempts in one use; a failed attempt replays at once), keepOnFail (a failed seal doesn't use it up). 'start' is the bag a new game gets (a starter pack until shops exist); 'refill' is what PATCH tops the Seal Scrolls up to when he heals. Numbers are first guesses.

seal_scroll.name: Seal Scroll
seal_scroll.desc: The basic seal. Cheap and common.

gilded_scroll.name: Gilded Scroll
gilded_scroll.desc: A strong bond is more likely.

group_chat_scroll.name: Group Chat Scroll
group_chat_scroll.desc: All four of you tap together: much bigger windows.

glass_scroll.name: Glass Scroll
glass_scroll.desc: Emberwick glass. A perfect seal is a guaranteed strong bond; one miss and it shatters.

echo_scroll.name: Echo Scroll
echo_scroll.desc: Plays the beat once before you tap, so you can learn it.

nightfall_scroll.name: Nightfall Scroll
nightfall_scroll.desc: Made for the dark. (Night-time bonus comes with the day/night cycle.)

draft_scroll.name: Draft Scroll
draft_scroll.desc: From PATCH's scrapped drafts. Glitchy, but it can seal glitched Relic Patchlings.

relic_scroll.name: Relic Scroll
relic_scroll.desc: Very rare. For legendaries and quest Patchlings.

rain_check_scroll.name: Rain Check Scroll
rain_check_scroll.desc: Sold cheap by the Tally. If the seal fails it's rescheduled: the scroll isn't used up.

triple_stack_scroll.name: Triple Stack Scroll
triple_stack_scroll.desc: Extra patty, extra cheese, extra tries: three attempts in one scroll. Callum always buys this one.
